question: Who among the following was selected as the new Director General of the International Solar Alliance (ISA) during the seventh session, held in New Delhi in November 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashish Khanna**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ashish Khanna** was appointed as the new Director General of the International Solar Alliance (ISA) during its seventh session held in **New Delhi in November 2024**.
 
• The International Solar Alliance (ISA) is a coalition of solar-resource-rich countries working to promote sustainable energy solutions and increase the adoption of solar energy globally.
 
• Prior to his appointment, Ashish Khanna held prominent positions in renewable energy initiatives and was recognized for his contributions to advancing clean energy technologies.
 
• ISA’s seventh session focused on accelerating the deployment of solar energy and highlighted the role of leadership in achieving global energy transitions.
 
• The appointment of Ashish Khanna aligns with ISA’s mission to drive innovative strategies and partnerships for harnessing solar energy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Solar Alliance (ISA):**

 
 
• Founded in 2015, ISA is an initiative jointly launched by India and France during COP21 in Paris.
 
• Its primary objective is to mobilize over $1 trillion in investments by 2030 for solar energy projects and reduce reliance on fossil fuels.
 
• The alliance is headquartered in Gurugram, India, and works with member countries to implement solar energy solutions.
 
 
 
• **Solar Energy:**
 
 
• Solar energy is a renewable energy source harnessed from the Sun’s radiation.
 
• It can be converted into electricity using photovoltaic (PV) cells or concentrated solar power (CSP) systems.
 
• Solar energy is crucial for reducing greenhouse gas emissions and combating climate change.
 
 
 
• **Global Energy Transition:**
 
 
• Energy transition refers to the shift from fossil fuels to renewable energy sources like solar, wind, and hydropower.
 
• This transition aims to achieve sustainable development, energy security, and environmental conservation.
 
 
 
• **Clean Energy Leadership:**
 
 
• Effective leadership in clean energy involves fostering innovation, partnerships, and policies to scale up renewable energy adoption.
 
• Global organizations like ISA play a pivotal role in guiding countries toward sustainable energy practices.
